items.question: What actions must the ritual performer complete after giving ornaments to the guru?
premises: The kartā gives ornaments and other items to the guru.
After this giving, the kartā is enjoined to partake of the caru.
The term tataḥ indicates that consuming the caru follows the prior act.
items.inference: Therefore the ritual performer must first gift ornaments and the like to the guru and then eat the caru-oblation.
items.plain_english: Having given ornaments and other offerings to the guru, the performer should then partake of the caru.
